description: This file declares the TensorListReserveSPMDExpander class, which is a specialized SPMD expander for tensor list reserve operations within the TensorFlow DTensor MLIR project. It includes method declarations for expanding operations and computing layouts, indicating its role in tensor layout transformation during compilation.
external_methods: StatusOr<llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>> ComputeLayoutForward(mlir::Operation* op, const llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>& input_layouts)
StatusOr<llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>> ComputeLayoutBackward(mlir::Operation* op, const llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>& output_layouts)

classes.name: TensorListReserveSPMDExpander
classes.description: A class deriving from SPMDExpanderBase, responsible for expanding tensor list reserve operations and computing their tensor layouts in the MLIR optimizer.

methods.name: ExpandOp
methods.description: Expands the given MLIR operation related to tensor list reserve into its SPMD form.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutForward
methods.description: Computes the tensor layout transformations in the forward direction based on input layouts.
